summary: Crawford County, MO: a 1944 place-name study lists a Westover lookout tower on a Clark National Forest map; the record marks it removed. No build date or height found.

facts.agency: Listed only as the National Forest (Central US Lookouts); the 1944 study cites a Clark National Forest map; the Clark and Mark Twain forests were consolidated into the Mark Twain National Forest in 1973
facts.status_note: The record marks the tower removed. No source I found dates the removal or describes the site today.

corrections.why: The record gives only National Forest. The 1944 place-name study cites a Clark National Forest map for this tower. The Clark and Mark Twain forests were consolidated in 1973, so the proposed name should carry that history. Open for the editor: the story keeps the listing's wording and does not name the agency as Clark.

notes_for_editor: The only tower-specific evidence is one line on the Central US Lookouts page (code, agency, Removed) and the 1944 place-name study (spelled Westovee there; a 1944 M.A. thesis by Gertrude M. Zimmer, University of Missouri-Columbia, cited on the SHSMO page). No build date, height, staffing or removal date was found, and no source describes the site today. The Clark-to-Mark-Twain link follows from the 1944 map citation and the 1973 consolidation; no source places this tower on Clark land specifically. Wikipedia gives the post office as 1901-1927 and SHSMO gives 1900-1927 (not used). Radioreference forum returned HTTP 503. Second search found nothing further.
